reference_feature_provenance.notes: Descriptors use the fixed Kinetics VideoSwin reference, independent of the eval checkpoint used for prototype assignments. Training must use the same FrozenBackboneFeatureCache fingerprint.

protocol.percentile_definition: ascending midrank of mean raw predicted saliency_map per stage4 grid cell within its own frame; ties preserved
protocol.prototype_selection: highest mean anchor-to-member visual similarity among top-8 activated prototype groups

thresholds.scope: non-anchor members of the chosen graph group; before ranking/count limit

protocol.ranking: select prototype by full-group mean visual similarity; filter its non-anchor patches by ALL metric thresholds; rank survivors by visual_score descending, node ID ascending; retain query_patch_count (0 means all passing matches)
protocol.anchor_self_membership: included in group mean; omitted from matches to avoid duplicate input
protocol.small_group_policy: skip anchors below minimum retrieved matches
protocol.context_target: original patch inside red box; surrounding pixels provide context only
